'''New Ator''' was an [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] located in the [[New Ator system/Legends|New Ator system]], a part of the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was situated on the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|hyperlane]], which linked it to the [[Kemal Station system/Legends|Kemal Station]] and [[Trulalis system]]s. New Ator was a part of the informal grouping of [[Planet/Legends|planets]] known as the [[Regency Worlds/Legends|Regency Worlds]], and it was [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] by [[Atorese]] colonists in approximately [[80 BBY/Legends|80 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
New Ator was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square R-16.<ref name="TEA" />
